t: You're on Buckingham Gate, a street in Westminster close to Buckingham Palace. It has a number of embassies, hotels and businesses, and since September 2025 the Liberal Democrat headquarters has been here at number 66. Two men with long careers are linked to it. Sir Frederick Young, an Australian barrister and politician who served as agent-general for South Australia, died here. Sir Patrick Ashley Cooper lived here. He was governor of the Hudson's Bay Company for more than two decades and a director of the Bank of England.
